data.name: Belize
data.summary: Belize's income tax now applies only to employed persons, at 25% on income accruing in or derived from Belize (IBTA s. 6 as replaced by Act 40 of 2024). Others pay business tax on gross receipts of a trade, business or profession carried on in Belize. A passive investor living on foreign dividends and gains therefore pays no Belize income tax, and there is no capital gains or wealth tax. No inheritance tax was found (low confidence). The QRP residence programme (age 40+, USD 2,000 a month of foreign income) confirms exemption from tax on foreign income, capital gains and inheritance tax.

regimes.name: Ordinary residence
regimes.description: Territorial: income tax only on employed persons' Belize-source income; business tax on gross receipts of a business carried on in Belize. Foreign portfolio income is untaxed.
regimes.eligibility: Residence and immigration permit (e.g. permanent residence after one year, or QRP).

capital_gains.summary: There is no capital gains tax in the Income and Business Tax Act. From basis year 2020, income tax is charged only on employed persons (s. 6(2)-(3), Act 40 of 2024). Business tax applies to revenue receipts of a person carrying on a trade or business in Belize (Part XI definition of 'receipts' and 'revenue receipts', the latter excluding receipts of a capital nature).

open_questions: Stamp duty on transfers of Belize land and shares (around 5%-8%) not researched.
capital_gains.rate_basis: IBTA s. 6 (replaced 2024): no income tax on anyone other than employed persons; capital receipts excluded from business tax base. No CGT legislation found.
capital_gains.professional_trader: A person carrying on a trade in Belize (e.g. real estate developers, share-transfer sales) pays business tax on gross receipts (1.75% for real estate sales and share transfer sales, Ninth Schedule).

dividends.summary: A passive individual is not liable to income tax (employed persons only) and not liable to business tax unless carrying on a business in Belize. Foreign dividends are therefore untaxed. Dividends are listed as business-tax receipts at 15% (Ninth Schedule (h)) for persons carrying on a business in Belize.

dividends.rate_basis: Act 40 of 2024 s. 6(2): no income tax on non-employed persons; business tax only on receipts of a person carrying on trade/business in Belize (IBTA s. 106 and Part XI definitions).
dividends.treaty_network: CARICOM agreement, UK (1947), Austria and a few others.

wealth_tax.summary: No wealth tax found in Belize law.

inheritance.summary: No inheritance, estate or gift tax was found. The Belize Tourism Board states that QRP members are exempt from inheritance tax, which suggests some estate duty may exist for non-QRP residents; not verified.

residency.tax_residency_test: Not relevant for a passive investor given the territorial, employment-only income tax; residence is otherwise judged on facts.

routes.name: Qualified Retirement Program (QRP)
routes.requirements: Age 40+; foreign retirement income of at least USD 2,000 a month deposited in Belize; dependants include spouse and children under 18; 30 consecutive days a year in Belize. QRP members are exempt from tax on foreign income, capital gains and inheritance tax (Belize Tourism Board). Qualifying nationalities include Commonwealth, US, EU and South American countries.

routes.requirements: After one year of continuous residence; not researched.

corporate.summary: Companies pay business tax on gross receipts (generally 1.75%-19.5% depending on activity, Ninth Schedule); no profit-based CIT for most companies (petroleum operations 40%).

succession.name: Belize
succession.summary: A will is free, but a court can order maintenance for dependants out of the estate (Wills Act, Cap. 203, Part II). There is no fixed share for children. Belize is a common-law country with trusts and, I believe, a private-foundation statute, but it is not in the Hague Trusts Convention; those two points need confirming.
succession.family_claims: The Wills Act (Cap. 203) has an Inheritance (Family Provision) part giving the court power to order maintenance for dependants out of a testator's estate (s. 35 and following); the tests and time limit were not read.
succession.foreign_law_note: Common-law rule (not confirmed in a Belizean statute here): movables by the law of domicile, land by the law of its location. No right to choose the law of nationality was found.
succession.trust_note: Belize has an own trust statute for local and international trusts (the Trusts Act, Cap. 202; the 1992 international trusts regime is widely cited) and a Private Foundations Act 2010; neither text was read here, so the entries rest on general knowledge and are flagged. Not a party to the Hague Trusts Convention. Foreign-trust tax treatment was not sourced.
open_questions: Trusts Act and Private Foundations Act 2010 were not read; domestic_trusts and private_foundations rest on general knowledge. Confirm the Act numbers and any firewall provision for heirship claims.
Family provision tests, class of applicants and time limit in Cap. 203 Part II were not read.
